data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all repository files, including the PKGBUILD, and found no malicious injections. The package downloads a self-extracting archive from the official GAMS CDN pinned with a SHA-256 checksum, which is standard and secure for proprietary software. The qwen model's inconclusive result was solely due to API errors during the full review phase, not a security finding.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of tool failure. The qwen model encountered HTTP 400 errors when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD and .desktop file in the full review phase, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model completed the review successfully and found the package safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and gams-studio.desktop due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors, resulting in a missing verdict signal for the full review.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) during the full file review phase to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts when the initial PKGBUILD safety gate has already passed.
